title: How the region fits together, on one chart
dek: How The Upskilling Labs of Greater Washington is organised, the dates the Cycle runs on, the route a person takes through both, and what we’re building next: kits, neighborhood workshops, salons, meetups, summits and an open commons.
cover_alt: A chart of five rows of steps: the organisation, the Cycle, a person’s route, and two dashed rows for what’s planned, with connectors between them.
